title: Apocalyptic Imagery
summary: Apocalyptic imagery uses vivid symbols, visions, beasts, numbers, cosmic signs, and heavenly scenes to reveal God’s rule and final victory.
background: Books like Daniel and Revelation use symbolic vision language. The images are meant to reveal, warn, comfort, and call God’s people to endurance.
teachingHelp: Explain symbolic language carefully and keep the focus on God’s sovereignty, Christ’s victory, and faithful endurance.
